title: paeonia veitchii subsp. altaica
intro: Paeonia veitchii subsp. altaica, commonly known as Peony, is a plant species that belongs to the Paeoniaceae family and is native to Central Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and alleviating anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia veitchii subsp. altaica include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
